# Eugene Zaiko - Senior Full-Stack Engineer

> Senior Full-Stack Engineer specializing in Node.js, NestJS, React, and Next.js. 5+ years building high-performance systems: event-driven architectures, PostgreSQL optimization (109M+ rows), and production AI applications.

## About

I build fast, thoughtful software — from developer tools and APIs to products used by millions. I care deeply about performance, accessibility, and craft.

Over 5+ years at PixelPlex, Syberry, and Linnovate, I've owned architecture at scale: 216 isolated databases, 109M+ records queried in under 5 seconds, and a production LLM media-processing engine shipped in 60 days.

## Key Projects

- **RealStream** (2026): AI-Native Media Orchestration - Event-driven ecosystem for generative AI video with queue-based prioritization and real-time WebSocket tracking
- **Perseus** (2025): 109M+ Records, 720x Faster - Industrial IoT analytics with hardware-aware PostgreSQL partitioning
- **Experts & Partners** (2024): 216+ Databases, Zero Downtime - Multi-tenant infrastructure for Tel Aviv University
- **Storm** (2023): Auto Resale Platform with guaranteed vehicle buy-back

## Technical Expertise

**Backend**: Node.js (NestJS), PHP (Symfony), BullMQ/RabbitMQ, REST & GraphQL APIs, Microservices

**Frontend**: React/Next.js, TypeScript, SSR & WebSockets, Redux Toolkit, Tailwind CSS

**Data**: PostgreSQL, Redis, Query Optimization

**DevOps**: AWS (S3, EC2), Docker/Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, Nginx

## Experience

- **Senior Software Engineer** at PixelPlex (2025): Architected event-driven AI media platform from scratch, launching production-ready MVP in 2 months
- **Software Engineer** at Syberry (2024-2025): Optimized high-load PostgreSQL systems (109M+ records) from 1-hour queries to sub-5 seconds
